A QUICK HUDDLE

READ. REACT.
REPEAT.

Your blue sphere runs forward automatically. Swipe or drag anywhere to steer; movement follows your swipe with a little momentum. Arrow keys and A / D work too.

Avoid every red defender. Warning arrows show where they will arrive. Pass cleanly between two defenders for +50. Keep going to increase your score — and the pressure.

Choose Easy for more space, Medium for a balanced run, or Hardcore for fast interceptions. Press Space or Escape to pause.
